//: AUROS — TypeScript. Strict, and a little past strict.
astro/tsconfigs/strict turns on `strict: true` and the Astro globals. The additions below are
the ones that catch real defects in a site whose whole argument is that it does not overstate
noUncheckedIndexedAccess   an array lookup is `T | undefined`, because it is. This site reads
content collections by index in several places; without this flag
a missing document types as present and renders as blank.
exactOptionalPropertyTypes an optional prop is absent or a value, never explicitly undefined.
noImplicitOverride         a component that stops overriding something says so.
verbatimModuleSyntax       type-only imports are written as such, so the emitted graph is
`astro check` runs this in `pnpm build`, so a type error stops a publish rather than shipping.
